body:
Source: repository documentation audit of 2026-09-20 (docs hygiene report, items 1-6 and 8). Re-verified on main @ b2b5c6ea. Every item below is a sentence in a living document that the code or the tree contradicts today. Nothing here depends on whether the context-handoff feature is kept or retired: the fix is a truthful status statement, never removal of the feature's documentation.

GROUND TRUTH (read first; none of these files is edited by this ticket).
- plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/hooks.json dispatches the verbs rails, buildgate, preflight, context, flail, manifest, review. There is no handoff verb, and PreToolUse matches Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit only (not Bash).
- plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/hooks.json PreToolUse runs adlc-rails-guard.mjs and adlc-build-gate.mjs. hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs still ships but no entry runs it. Neither plugin has a setting that turns the gate on.
- plugins/adlc-pi/lib/extension.mjs:103 and plugins/adlc-opencode/index.mjs:96 read env.ADLC_CONTEXT_ROT_HANDOFF_ENABLED === '1'; the call sites (extension.mjs:434, index.mjs:224 and :301) run only when it is set. OpenCode reads it from the process environment only (index.mjs:89-95: deliberately not mapped from plugin options).
- packages/build-gate/lib/depth-signal.mjs:23 still imports the band thresholds from @adlc/context-handoff, and `adlc handoff` is a registered CLI verb. The package is live; only the session-terminal deny (D1-D3) is unwired.
- CHANGELOG.md:30 records the 1.11.1 disconnect (#966). docs/integrations/claude-code.md:144,:271,:299 and docs/integrations/pi.md:98-105 already state it correctly; reuse their vocabulary and their link https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/issues/966.
- .adlc/tickets.json does not exist in this repo (`git cat-file -e HEAD:.adlc/tickets.json` fails); the store is the sharded directory .adlc/tickets/. The single file is still a supported ADOPTER format, so mentions in plugin and adopter docs are correct and stay.
- CONVENTIONS.md:35-46 is the canonical core rule: core is frozen to ADDITIONS; a defect in an existing core primitive is fixed in core, with a regression test in packages/core/test/.
- Every Appendix C tool (ADLC.md headings C1-C14) exists as packages/<name>. packages/fleet (#165), packages/tickets (#180, store migrated in #321), plugins/adlc-herdr (#333), the pi native flush (#118 #121 #122 #125 #131), the OpenCode continuation (tickets T30-T35, completed 2026-07-10) and packages/backlog-groom (#1012 #1016) have shipped; confirm each with `git log --oneline --grep` before citing it.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Documentation plus ONE new test file; no package code, no hooks.json, no plugin source, no existing test. The new test lives in the glob-run scripts segment (`node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs`), so scripts/run-tests.mjs needs no edit. Model it on scripts/test/handoff-wiring-drift.test.mjs: parse ground truth STRUCTURALLY, then assert the prose agrees, so a rewording is free and a false claim is not. Hand-maintained copies are edited by hand; never run scripts/generate-tool-docs.mjs.
Wording constraints that existing gates impose on every sentence you add:
- scripts/check-reviewer-directed-comments.mjs scans the WHOLE blank-line-delimited paragraph around any touched line of a .md/.mdx file (regexes at :187 and :197). Do not write, in any touched paragraph or in the new test's comments, a reference to how this change was examined (numbered passes, numbered defects, who examined it) or a verdict word from its phrase list (for example: acceptable, harmless, benign, invalid, dismissed, works as intended, accepted risk, safe to ignore). Verified at b2b5c6ea: no paragraph this ticket touches matches either regex today.
- scripts/claude-code-plugin-smoke.mjs scans README.md, AGENTS.md and docs/** for a bare /adlc-<command>; write the scoped form /adlc:adlc-<command> or none.
- apps/docs/test/codex-docs-current.test.mjs:109 rejects the word inactive followed anywhere later by the ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT=1 unless-clause across codex.mdx + docs/integrations/codex.md: do not use the word inactive in codex.mdx. Lines :30-32 and :36-54 pin three phrases and the install commands in codex.mdx: leave install and surface-count text alone.
- apps/docs/test/integrations-gemini.test.mjs:85-95: no harness page may contain 'coming soon' or 'This page is being written'.
- packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs:140-141 scans every tracked .md/.mdx line: never put 'nothing to check' or 'no criteria found' on a line that also says passes or a bare 0.
- MDX is not built in CI. In .mdx prose never write a bare < or { outside backticks or a code fence. Use the existing callout form at apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/copilot.mdx:32-40 (Callout with type warn: opening tag on its own line, text, closing tag) with NO blank line inside, so the callout is one paragraph.
- plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs:1394-1398 and :2118-2127 pin the recovery recipe `rm -rf <repo>/.adlc/handoffs <repo>/.adlc/.deny-store` and the bash block after 'If you do not have the key' in plugins/adlc-pi/README.md: do not touch that part of the file.
- scripts/block-secret-exposure.mjs:124 cites the AGENTS.md heading 'ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY: never let it become an argument': keep it verbatim.
- Plugin READMEs ship in npm tarballs: links in them are absolute GitHub URLs.

NORMATIVE DECISIONS.
A. Context-handoff status. Three fixed statements; adapt grammar only.
 A1 UNWIRED (Claude Code, Codex). TEXT: **Not wired since 1.11.1** ([#966](https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/issues/966)). The plugin's `hooks/hooks.json` has no entry for this gate, so nothing in this section runs in a current install, and no setting turns it on. The hook code still ships and is still tested. The rest of this section describes the gate as it behaves when wired.
 A2 OPT-IN (pi, OpenCode). TEXT: **Off by default since 1.11.1** ([#966](https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/issues/966)). The gate runs only when `ADLC_CONTEXT_ROT_HANDOFF_ENABLED=1` is set in the environment the harness starts from. That flag decides whether the gate runs at all; it does not clear an active deny. The rest of this section describes the gate with the flag set. For OpenCode add: The flag is read from the process environment only, not from `opencode.json` plugin options.
 A3 PACKAGE. TEXT: **Status since 1.11.1** ([#966](https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/issues/966)): no harness evaluates the session-terminal deny (D1-D3) by default. The Claude Code and Codex plugins ship without the hook entry; pi and OpenCode run the gate only with `ADLC_CONTEXT_ROT_HANDOFF_ENABLED=1`. The band thresholds are still consumed by `build-gate`, and the `adlc handoff` CLI is unaffected.
 Placement (a callout in .mdx, a > blockquote in .md, always the FIRST paragraph under the heading named):
 - apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/codex.mdx, heading Context-rot handoff (:74): A1; then reword :76-78 so it no longer says Codex is an enforcing tier or that a third PreToolUse hook evaluates in the present tense (When wired, a third ...).
 - apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/opencode.mdx, heading Context-rot handoff (:125): A2 plus the OpenCode sentence; reword :127 the same way (With the flag set, ...).
 - apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/pi.mdx, heading Context-rot handoff (:100): A2; reword :102 the same way.
 - apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/claude-code.mdx: the :46 cell becomes: Hooks block frozen-rail edits and gate fitness-to-build on structured edits (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit). The :56 bullet becomes: **Hooks:** structured-edit rails-guard and build-gate + CI backstop. The context-handoff deny is not wired since 1.11.1 ([#966](https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/issues/966)); see [context-handoff](/docs/toolkit/context-handoff).
 - apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/context-handoff.mdx: A3 as a callout between the phase line (:8) and the PhaseDiagram; nothing else on the page changes.
 - apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/index.mdx:44 row: append: The deny is not wired by any harness by default since 1.11.1 (opt-in on pi and OpenCode).
 - docs/package-reference.md:16 row: append: Since 1.11.1 no harness wires the deny by default (opt-in on pi and OpenCode via `ADLC_CONTEXT_ROT_HANDOFF_ENABLED=1`); the bands and the CLI are unaffected.
 - docs/integrations/pi.md:22 row: **Shipped** becomes **Shipped, off by default since 1.11.1** - runs only with `ADLC_CONTEXT_ROT_HANDOFF_ENABLED=1` (see 3.5); keep the rest of the cell.
 - packages/context-handoff/README.md: A3 as a blockquote after the intro paragraph (:3-6), before the usage block.
 - plugins/adlc-codex/README.md: heading Context-rot handoff gate (:42) gets A1 and :44 moves to: When wired, the plugin's `adlc-handoff-gate` hook runs on every tool call. The install paragraph (:8-14) keeps Use `@adlc/cli` **1.11.0 or newer** but replaces the handoff-gate rationale and the binding-constraint clause with a pointer to the suite-wide floor at https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/blob/main/docs/toolkit.md#version-requirements (docs/toolkit.md:38 is where the floor lives); keep the 1.4.2 MCP sentence.
 - plugins/adlc-pi/README.md: the :51-53 bullet says the gate is off by default since 1.11.1 and needs the flag; heading The handoff gate (:82) gets A2; :77 'with one deliberate exception, the handoff gate below' gains (when it is enabled).
B. AGENTS.md.
 - :24-28: ...forbids any change to an existing ticket's contract in the ticket store (`.adlc/tickets/`).
 - :30 heading becomes: ## The ticket store is the rail trust root (no inbound anchor exists: `git grep -n is-the-rail-trust-root` is empty).
 - :51-62 (the tickets.json rebase-conflict subsection): delete. Shards are one immutable file per ticket, so that conflict cannot occur, and its command fails here.
 - :76-79: stop asserting checkout state. TEXT: `git stash` has a sharper edge: the stash list is shared by every worktree of a checkout, so it can hold entries from other branches and other sessions. `git stash push` on a clean tree saves nothing, so a later `git stash pop` silently pops *someone else's* entry. Keep the recovery block.
 - :97: Never work in the primary checkout itself (the first entry of `git worktree list`).
 - :108-110. TEXT: Two sessions in the same checkout share **one index and one `HEAD`**: a `checkout`, `commit`, `rebase`, or `stash` from either lands on the other's work. A `git worktree` has its own index and `HEAD`, which is what isolates it.
 - Leave every other section as it is, including :35-49 and :100-106.
C. Core rule. CONTRIBUTING.md:69-70 and apps/docs/content/docs/reference/conventions.mdx:33-35 become a two-sentence restatement of CONVENTIONS.md rule 2: never ADD to `packages/core/` (implement locally, note it in the README section named Core gaps); a defect in an existing core primitive is fixed in core with a regression test in `packages/core/test/`. CONTRIBUTING links CONVENTIONS.md; the .mdx keeps its existing absolute link. Do not merge or shorten the rest of either list.
D. README.md Project layout (:167-180): the `packages/` row drops the number (The toolkit: zero-dependency, gate-shaped CLIs, one directory per tool); the four `plugins/adlc-*` rows collapse into ONE row `plugins/` (Native harness integrations, one `adlc-<name>/` directory each); `.claude/commands/` becomes `.claude/skills/` (Maintainer skills for this repo; the release procedure is `.claude/release-profile.md`); the `.adlc/` row says the ticket store, specs, lessons and gate-evidence manifest are tracked and session-local state is gitignored. The docs/, scripts/ and .claude-plugin/ rows are unchanged.
E. ADLC.md. Keep the Appendix C heading byte-identical. :539 'Tools that should exist and mostly don't.' becomes: The tools this lifecycle needs. Every tool below now ships as `packages/<name>` in this repository. At :542-543 'with a build-priority verdict at the end' becomes 'the order they were prioritised in is recorded at the end'. The :712 heading becomes ### Build priority (historical), followed by one sentence: Every tool in this table has shipped; it records the order they were prioritised in and why. :721-725 moves to the past tense (made; at the time, the unmeasured ...). C1-C14 bodies and the table rows are untouched.
F. Status lines (line 3, or line 7 for the herdr plan). Replace only the Status sentence; keep Ticket/Approval/Branch/Inputs lines. Each new status names the implementing path in backticks and says the document is kept as the design record:
 - docs/specs/fleet-orchestration.md: Status: SHIPPED - implemented as `packages/fleet` (#165). This is the approved P1 spec, kept as the design record; where it and the code differ, `packages/fleet/README.md` is current.
 - docs/specs/sharded-ticket-store.md: **Status:** Shipped - `packages/tickets` (#180); this repository's own store migrated in #321.
 - docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-13-sharded-ticket-store.md: > **Status:** Executed - shipped as `packages/tickets` (#180, migrated here in #321). Kept as the record of the rollout plan. Then the existing pointer sentences.
 - docs/herdr-integration-plan.md:7: Status: **shipped** - built as `plugins/adlc-herdr` (first merged in #333). This document is the original plan, kept as the design record. Keep the companion-tickets sentence.
 - docs/specs/pi-native-flush.md: Status: SHIPPED - Phases 1-5 merged into `plugins/adlc-pi` (#118, #121, #122, #125, #131). The to-do language below describes the state before that work.
 - docs/specs/opencode-integration-continuation.md: Status: SHIPPED - executed as tickets T30-T35 in `plugins/adlc-opencode`, all completed 2026-07-10.
 - docs/intent/backlog-grooming.md: Status: **confirmed intent**, since specified (`.adlc/specs/backlog-grooming.md`) and built as `packages/backlog-groom` (#1012, #1016). Keep the rest of the paragraph.
G. Package counts: remove the number, never correct it, in the undated living documents only: README.md:26 and :171, CONVENTIONS.md:4, apps/docs/content/docs/reference/conventions.mdx:3, apps/docs/content/docs/reference/index.mdx:8, docs/integrations/claude-code.md:6, .claude/skills/release-audit/SKILL.md:5 (every package and every host plugin), and apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/cli.mdx:57, which is a sample of generated output (packages/cli/bin/adlc.mjs:49 prints the live number): replace the number 24 with the literal placeholder <N> and change nothing else on that line (it is inside a code fence). Dated records keep their numbers because each is a fact about its date: docs/adr/0002 :182, docs/adr/0003 :17, .claude/release-profile.md:118 and :126, docs/intent/booster-adoption.md:6, :225, :226.
H. Dead relative links: docs/adr/0016-issue-autopilot-local-substrate.md:11 points at ./0007-multimodel-adversarial-review.md; docs/integrations/opencode.md:10 drops the Adoption guide sentence (docs/opencode.md was removed in #99 and this page IS the adoption guide) and keeps The full thesis link; docs/integrations/copilot-probe-appendix.md:3 turns the link into plain text: the Copilot integration plan (not part of this repository's main branch).
I. The new test, scripts/test/docs-truth.test.mjs, one test() per group, each conditioned on ground truth so it cannot outlive the fact it checks:
 1. Parse both hooks.json files and the two opt-in source lines. For a harness whose gate is unwired or opt-in, the first paragraph under the handoff heading of each section surface (codex.mdx, opencode.mdx, pi.mdx, plugins/adlc-codex/README.md, plugins/adlc-pi/README.md, docs/integrations/pi.md 3.5) contains 1.11.1 and #966 or issues/966, plus ADLC_CONTEXT_ROT_HANDOFF_ENABLED for pi and OpenCode. For a harness that IS wired the same paragraph must NOT contain those markers (symmetric, so re-wiring forces the docs to follow).
 2. The text before the first second-level heading of toolkit/context-handoff.mdx and of packages/context-handoff/README.md contains the same three markers.
 3. The context-handoff row of toolkit/index.mdx, of docs/package-reference.md, of docs/integrations/pi.md, the pi README feature bullet (with its wrapped continuation lines), and every line of claude-code.mdx that contains handoff carries a status marker (1.11.1, #966, off by default, not wired or opt-in).
 4. AGENTS.md: when .adlc/tickets.json is absent and .adlc/tickets/.store.json present, it never names .adlc/tickets.json; it contains no /Users/ or /home/ absolute path; it does not say a worktree shares an index; it does not assert that this repo carries stashes.
 5. Rule 2 of CONTRIBUTING.md and of conventions.mdx each contain 'fixed in core' and do not contain 'Never edit', asserted only after the same extraction from CONVENTIONS.md contains 'fixed in core'.
 6. Every backticked path in column 1 of the README Project layout table exists; when .gitignore un-ignores .adlc/tickets/, the .adlc/ row does not say 'gitignored except'.
 7. Every C-numbered heading in ADLC.md Appendix C names an existing packages/<name>/package.json; when all do, the Appendix C lead paragraph does not contain 'mostly don't' and the Build priority heading or its first paragraph says historical or shipped.
 8. For each [document, implementing path] pair in F whose path exists, the first Status line in the top 12 lines does not contain PROPOSED, pending or 'not yet'.
 9. No line of the undated living documents in G, plus CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md, contains a two-digit number (optionally prefixed by ~) followed by one of: independently built, zero-dependency, tools, packages, CLIs (verified at b2b5c6ea: this matches exactly the eight lines listed in G and nothing else).
 10. Every ./ or ../ markdown link in the three files of H resolves on disk.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 The new test is written first and every one of its ten tests fails before any document is edited (paste the failing summary into the PR body). verify: `node --test scripts/test/docs-truth.test.mjs` reports fail 10 on the branch before the doc commits
- AC2 Handoff status is stated on every surface in A. verify: `node --test scripts/test/docs-truth.test.mjs` (groups 1-3 pass) and `grep -LF '1.11.1' apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/claude-code.mdx apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/codex.mdx apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/opencode.mdx apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/pi.mdx apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/context-handoff.mdx apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/index.mdx plugins/adlc-codex/README.md plugins/adlc-pi/README.md docs/package-reference.md docs/integrations/pi.md packages/context-handoff/README.md` prints nothing
- AC3 AGENTS.md matches this repo's store and git's worktree semantics. verify: `node --test scripts/test/docs-truth.test.mjs` (group 4) and `grep -cE 'tickets[.]json|/Users/' AGENTS.md` prints 0
- AC4 The core rule reads the same in all three places. verify: `node --test scripts/test/docs-truth.test.mjs` (group 5) and `grep -c 'fixed in core' CONTRIBUTING.md apps/docs/content/docs/reference/conventions.mdx` prints 1 or more for each file
- AC5 README layout, Appendix C tense, status lines, counts and links are true. verify: `node --test scripts/test/docs-truth.test.mjs` (groups 6-10 pass; whole file reports fail 0)
- AC6 Every existing test that reads these documents is green and unedited. verify: `node --test scripts/test/handoff-wiring-drift.test.mjs scripts/test/ticket-store-docs.test.mjs scripts/test/p6-close-step-docs.test.mjs scripts/test/skills-catalog.test.mjs scripts/test/preflight.test.mjs scripts/test/npm-install-warning.test.mjs scripts/test/release-audit-skill.test.mjs apps/docs/test/codex-docs-current.test.mjs apps/docs/test/integration-facts.test.mjs apps/docs/test/integrations-gemini.test.mjs apps/docs/test/toolkit-usage-dispatcher.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/status-schema.test.mjs packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs` and `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs`, then `git diff --stat origin/main -- '*.test.mjs'` lists only scripts/test/docs-truth.test.mjs
- AC7 The two segments that own these tests are green. verify: `node scripts/run-tests.mjs scripts 'docs app'` prints 2/2 segments passed
- AC8 The prose guards pass. verify: `node scripts/claude-code-plugin-smoke.mjs .` exits 0, `node scripts/check-reviewer-directed-comments.mjs origin/main` exits 0, and `grep -c 'ci/rails-guard.yml' docs/integrations/opencode.md` prints 1 or more
- AC9 Nothing outside the declared file set changed, and no ground-truth file changed. verify: `git diff --name-only origin/main | grep -vE '[.]mdx?$|^scripts/test/docs-truth[.]test[.]mjs$|^[.]adlc/'` prints nothing
- AC10 Mutation gate. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 and prints no source files changed (markdown and test files are not mutable sources, so the red-then-green run in AC1 is the behavioural evidence)

OUT OF SCOPE: deleting, moving or archiving any document; collapsing docs/tools into the package READMEs or any catalog merge; adding a CLAUDE.md; anything that presumes context-handoff is retired, including docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md and its .adlc/specs twin; compressing AGENTS.md or the issue-lanes skill; AGENTS.md:35-49; the garbled sentence at codex.mdx:85-88 and opencode.mdx:137-140; catalog coverage gaps; docs/models-by-phase.md; .gitignore; stale core-is-frozen source comments in packages/*/lib; the deleted-path citations in docs/toolkit.md:97 and packages/prosecute/README.md:115.
title: docs: state what ships - handoff gate status, ticket-store guidance, core rule, layout, shipped-status lines, counts, dead links
